name: Oculus
description: Round windows with their glazing bars left open, so the light comes through the gaps and not the paint.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 6%; border-radius: 50%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: radial-gradient(circle closest-side at 50% 50%, transparent 72%, #000 72%); mask: radial-gradient(circle closest-side at 50% 50%, transparent 72%, #000 72%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 6%; border-radius: 50%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: radial-gradient(circle closest-side at 50% 50%, #000 70%, transparent 70%), repeating-linear-gradient(@pick(0deg, 45deg), #000 0 6%, transparent 6% 50%); mask: radial-gradient(circle closest-side at 50% 50%, #000 70%, transparent 70%), repeating-linear-gradient(@pick(0deg, 45deg), #000 0 6%, transparent 6% 50%); -webkit-mask-composite: source-in; mask-composite: intersect; -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
